clip34.title: A black hole the size of an ATOM could blow up a star #Shorts
clip34.description:
A new MIT theory (Astrophysical Journal): an atom-sized primordial black hole, about a millionth of Earth's mass, could sink into a star, eat about 1% of it over several million years, and then make it explode within seconds. What signal astronomers would look for. Theoretical: none has been observed yet.
